mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) indicates robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO m/m change is positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 2.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising inflation rate (CPIAUCSL m/m > 0.2%) combined with low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) signals moderate inflation and strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when CPIAUCSL m/m > 0.2% and UNRATE < 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (defined as FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising for 3 months (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive month-over-month change in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when PAYEMS m/m change is positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a weak housing market and economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1500 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS m/m > 0.5%) combined with high housing starts (HOUST > 1600) signals robust consumer and housing demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when RSAFS m/m > 0.5% and HOUST > 1600 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a supply contraction (defined as INDPRO < 95, index 2017=100), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 95 (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
